question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Oblegation"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Obligation".

 
 
• **English Meaning:** Obligation refers to a duty or commitment that one is bound to fulfill. (कर्तव्य/अनिवार्यता)
 
• **Example:** Every citizen has an obligation to abide by the law.
 
 
 
• **Correct Word:** "Obligation" (कर्तव्य/अनिवार्यता)
 
 
• **Example:** She has an obligation to complete her work before the deadline.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Overview** (सारांश): A general summary or outline of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher gave us an overview of the entire syllabus.
 
 
 
• **Opponent** (प्रतिद्वंद्वी): A person who is against or competes with someone in a contest, debate, or conflict.
 
 
• **Example:** She defeated her opponent in the final match.
 
 
 
• **Ointment** (मरहम): A smooth substance applied to the skin for healing or soothing.
 
 
• **Example:** He applied an ointment to the wound to reduce the pain.
